title: Supply Area Door Handle (Latent Print/Handling Area Documentation)
prompt:
1) Function (1 sentence)
Document a close-up, forensic-quality color photograph of the supply area door handle and the primary handling zone for latent print processing.

2) Scene / Composition (3–5 sentences; include subject percentage in frame)
Single-frame close-up of a plain, unbranded brushed-metal lever-style door handle mounted on a neutral painted door surface, with the handle and immediate surrounding plate occupying ~70% of the frame. Place one small forensic scale (L-shaped, metric, high-contrast) adjacent to the handle without covering potential ridge detail. Include discrete annotation markers: two small evidence tents labeled with simple numerals positioned near the most-touched areas (e.g., base of lever and underside of lever) without obscuring surfaces. Lighting is from a direct forensic flash producing crisp, controlled specular highlights on metal while keeping overall exposure even; background remains minimal and non-distracting.

3) Angle & Distance (strict numeric values)
Angle: 15° off-perpendicular to the door plane (near-straight-on). Subject distance: 0.45 m from the handle to camera.

4) Optics & Technique (lens mm, f/, 1/x s, ISO, WB K, focus, DOF)
Lens: 60 mm macro; aperture f/11; shutter 1/200 s; ISO 200; white balance 5600 K. Focus locked on the top surface of the lever with deep enough depth of field to keep the handle edges and scale markings sharp. Use on-camera flash (forensic flash look) with minimal ambient contribution; no motion blur.

5) Mandatory elements (labels/markers/timestamps already present in the case)
Forensic scale present and readable; photo annotation present as small numbered evidence tents only (no case name, no evidenceId, no dates/times, no location text).

6) Negatives (objective list of what MUST NOT appear)
No people, hands, gloves, faces, reflections showing a person, or identifiable biometrics. No real logos/brands, no readable facility signage, no door number, no official badges/insignia. No blood, weapons, or graphic content. No written case identifiers, evidenceId, or timestamps embedded in the image.

7) Acceptance checklist (objective, verifiable bullets)
- Handle and surrounding contact area fill ~70% of the frame and are sharply focused.
- One metric forensic scale is visible, unobstructed, and legible.
- Two small numbered annotation tents are present and do not cover the handle’s likely touch surfaces.
- Color image with controlled forensic-flash lighting and even exposure.
- No persons, no brands/logos, no signage, no timestamps, and no case/evidence identifiers appear in-frame.
